run_interop_server: run the gRPC interoperability test server on a specified port with optional TLS or ALTS credentials
parse_interop_server_arguments: parse command line arguments for port, TLS, and ALTS settings for the interop test server
get_server_credentials: get SSL or ALTS server credentials based on the use_tls flag for secure gRPC connections
serve: start the gRPC interop test server with TestService and wait for termination on the configured port
add_TestServiceServicer_to_server: register the TestService servicer to the gRPC server to handle interop test RPC calls
